name: When should I consider accessible appliance space planning for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider accessible appliance space planning for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to consider accessible appliance space planning early in any renovation or new construction project, especially if you or a family member currently has mobility challenges, or if you are planning to age in place. Integrating accessibility from the start is typically more cost-effective and less disruptive than retrofitting later. Even without immediate needs, proactive planning can enhance your home's long-term value and adaptability, making it suitable for future life changes or potential resale to a broader market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider accessible appliance space planning early in any renovation, especially if you have current or future mobility needs. It's more cost-effective and adds long-term value.
